issue_context.title: [migration] Fail framework creation when duplicate plugins registered at the same extension point
issue_context.body:
There is no reason this should be allowed to happen, especially that we can't configure duplicate plugins differently since plugin configs is a separate list .

/sig scheduling

review_comments: How about using a map or set to record plugin names, and use it to check new plugin name?
That would be a valid approach, but if it is for optimization, I don't think it is necessary...

I came up with another approach which avoids duplication with reflection https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/83243, what do you think of that? If it is a valid approach, I'd like to keep this one as it is. And if not, I could update this PR and close #83243
Reflection seems too much. @ahg-g 's suggestion makes more sense to me.
I added a comment to the other PR. I think we can use a variation of what you proposed there.
